title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Woven Days (strip cloth). Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Sketches show the Accra city page on a phone; values are sample data.

options.label: Woven Days
options.lineage: Strip-woven cloth: Asante and Ewe kente in the south, fugu smock strips in the north
options.thesis: A city's recent days woven as cloth strips: one block per day, its colour the condition that day.
materials: narrow woven strips sewn edge to edge
options.viewport: Black shell with a woven edge, today's headline condition in large type, then rain, heat and air as 14-day woven strips; map loads on tap.
options.risk: Becomes tourist pattern-wallpaper the moment a strip stops encoding real data; kente reads southern, so northern smock strips must carry Tamale equally.

raised.raise: Length is exact time: every block spans exactly one day, never stretched to fit the width.
Typographic economy: one workhorse family carries headline, figure and caption; hierarchy from size and weight only.
One condition owns the phone's first screen; the next topic is one tap away and already loaded.
Fixed registration: every strip, map and plate of a city shares one scale and extent, so change over time is honest.
One woven graphic leads each topic tab; everything around it stays quiet.

options.label: Signboard
options.lineage: Ghanaian hand-painted sign art: barbershop, chop bar and shopfront boards
options.thesis: Each condition painted as a signboard: one plain sentence, one picture, flat bold colour.
options.viewport: A painted 'ACCRA TODAY' board, a yellow board 'Heavy rain likely tonight' with a painted rain picture, value rows below.
options.risk: Needs real painted illustrations to live; without them it collapses into flat colour blocks. Also a familiar way to 'do Ghana'.

options.label: Departure Board
options.thesis: The five cities as rows on a live board; values flip when the data updates.
options.viewport: Board rows per condition for Accra with flipping values, amber lamp on the rain row.
options.case: Holds clarity for live status at a glance; loses identification — a station abroad, not a Ghanaian street.
options.risk: Feels imported, and the fixed cells cramp at 390 px.

options.label: Dance Score
options.thesis: Time read upward along a centre staff, block length as duration.
options.viewport: A vertical staff of the city's week, rain left, heat right.
options.case: Fuses poorly: residents cannot read a notation system on first sight.

options.label: Design Annual
options.thesis: The city page as a printed plate with registration marks.
options.viewport: Plate of Accra with crosshairs and a stamp seal.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a design-world artifact nobody in Kumasi or Tamale identifies with.
options.risk: Precious and cold for a public-service page.
options.kept: One workhorse type family for everything.

options.label: Vertical Feed
options.viewport: Full-screen rain card, next card one flick away.
options.case: Familiar on phones, but hides the overview and buries decision-makers' depth.
options.kept: One condition owns the first screen; the next is preloaded.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: The city at fixed scale across seasons and decades.
options.viewport: Accra built-up area 1975 to 2030 as aligned plates.
options.case: Strong for urban growth only; loses identification and the live job.
options.risk: Museum mood on a live page.
options.kept: Fixed scale and extent across time.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Data as a white line plot on black, names coded in colour.
options.viewport: A pulse plot of Accra's rain owning the screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: colour-coded labels fight plain language and accessibility.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean weather and air-quality app, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: City header, a grid of value tiles with icons, a map block below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any weather app by design.
